verified: construction and actor allocation failures do not publish partial objects
startup allocation failures run no entry actions and retain not-started state

failed publication does not call listeners
snapshot, stop-event and subscription allocation failures retain their specified stable state
invalid fault-point names reject without arming a failure
exact thrown error identity is retained
